label: sonnet5
sourceDraft: aceite a la lumbrera, aromas a aceite de la unción y a incienso de los aromas,
spanish: aceite a la lumbrera, aromas a aceite de la unción y a incienso de las especias,
grammarChanges: Replaced "de los aromas" with "de las especias" for H5561 (sourceTokenId h02025006007) so it is not rendered with the same noun as H1314 (h02025006003, "aromas"); changed the article from masculine "los" to feminine "las" to agree with "especias".
readerNote: Chose "especias" for H5561 to keep it distinct from H1314's "aromas"; both are licensed spice-sense synonyms, so no concept was added.
